description: Use this when the person asks what is still open or what to do next in their ProofPass account. Returns the open items the dashboard overview shows for the connected account (products without a document, old safety data sheets, failed deliveries, open requests and the like), each with the place in the dashboard where it is fixed. Labels are in German. Do not use for legal duties in general (use check_duties).

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: list_open_duties
title: Open items of my account
